system.description:
Muffles the sound of a firearm to only be heard in Short range, and prevents the sound from being heard if a wall or other cover is between the firing weapon and the potential hearing character.

Weight: +500g.

Weapon Modifications: The following modifications can be applied to any Short, Stock, or Energy ranged weapons. Applying the modification requires 1 hour of time.

Used to increase their range band by +1. Can be equipped to any Non-Archaic ranged weapon.

Weight: +800g.

Weapon Modifications: The following modifications can be applied to any Short, Stock, or Energy ranged weapons. Applying the modification requires 1 hour of time.

Allows for the character to aim the weapon in darkness without penalty, in addition to gaining +1 Range band.

Weight: +1500g.

Weapon Modifications: The following modifications can be applied to any Short, Stock, or Energy ranged weapons. Applying the modification requires 1 hour of time.

Used for Short weapons to increase their range by one range band and allows the weapon to be used for buttstock attacks.

Weight: +1000g.

Weapon Modifications: The following modifications can be applied to any Short, Stock, or Energy ranged weapons. Applying the modification requires 1 hour of time.

Same as Shoulder Stock, but allows the weapon to become a Short weapon as needed. Cannot be used for buttstock attacks.

Weight: +500g.

Weapon Modifications: The following modifications can be applied to any Short, Stock, or Energy ranged weapons. Applying the modification requires 1 hour of time.
